show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/NkHYT6
show.description: This is a love story between an artist who brings nature to life on canvas and a businessman who stands at the top of the corporate world. Like waves in the ocean, a series of events shape their lives, will those waves carry them safely to the shore, or pull them apart? You’ll have to watch to find out.
